svg.title: Experiment 009 Stage-B authenticated development overview
svg.desc: Experiment 009 Stage B compares four frozen methods on 32 MBPP development tasks. CQER-32 has task-macro aligned excess NLL 0.323944; composing it with a right randomized Hadamard transform has 0.153129, 52.73 percent lower. Aggregate local codec state SSE falls from 36409.363073 to 15345.844948, 57.85 percent lower. All eight frozen development advancement gates passed. This is not confirmation, novelty, speed, deployment, or breakthrough evidence.
